name: mcp-native-monorepo
description: Native application runtime for MCP, focused first on React Native.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.release:verify: npm run check && npm run package:smoke && node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 node --test tests/*.test.mjs
